_meta.note: simulated faults, one LabThings server, one action; ground truth read from the server

scenarios.F1: the response to the request is lost; the server acted
scenarios.F2: the connection is reset before the server sees the request
scenarios.F3: the server answers 503 and did not act
scenarios.F4: the request is accepted; every status poll is then lost
scenarios.F5: the action fails part-way (a stalled motor)
scenarios.F6: a cache serves the position as it was before the move
scenarios.F7: a target outside the declared limit (+/-1000)
scenarios.F6b: as F6, but the cached position is 2.5 s old (outside the 1 s blind spot of the Date-header stamp)

effort.openmhs_onboarding: one import command; judgement entries in the override file (see WOT_IMPORTER_RESULTS.md)
effort.note: lines of Python in this file, excluding comments; a rough size, not a quality measure

overhead.note: includes the action's own 1.5 s runtime in both; the difference is what the gateway adds (validation, authorization, journal writes, readback verification)
